title: 停水通知

lines.text: 星期一早上，杰克在小区门口看到一张停水通知，上面写着：因管道维修，星期三上午八点至晚上八点停水。

lines.en: On Monday morning, Jack sees a notice at the entrance to his housing estate. It says that, due to pipe repairs, the water will be off on Wednesday from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
